## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Architecture or ADR
- [ ] Source code
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Configuration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Deployment or tooling

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results.

## Risk and Safety Impact

Describe effects on trading decisions, risk enforcement, open-position management, or emergency behavior. Use `None` when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable.
- [ ] Requirements and ADRs are updated when necessary.
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes are identified.
